trial.missing: The trial's settings are missing: start it again from Administration.
trial.title: Trial sign-in
trial.lead: Signing in at the identity provider with the settings being tried, before they are saved.
trial.signedIn: Signed in at the provider. What rvav reads from the token is on the Administration page; this window closes.

signIn.title: Sign in to {{name}}

lead.api: rvav's API isn't answering: it may be starting again with newer settings.
lead.provider: Sign in with your organisation's account.
lead.noProvider: No identity provider is set up yet. Sign in as the local administrator to set one up in Administration.

signIn.or: or, when single sign-on is down
signIn.asLocal: Sign in as the local administrator
signIn.tooMany: Too many failed attempts in a row. Wait before trying again.
signIn.wrong: The username or password is wrong.
signIn.failed: Signing in didn't work. Try again in a moment.
signIn.unreachable: Can't reach the rvav API. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.providerDown: The identity provider can't be reached. Sign in as the local administrator, or try single sign-on again later.
signIn.refused: Signing in was refused or cancelled at the identity provider. Sign in with single sign-on to try again, or as the local administrator.

password.title: Change the administrator's password
password.lead: Choose your own password before going on: the one you signed in with was given at installation, or by a reset.
password.newHint: At least {{min}} characters, other than the current one.
password.failed: Changing the password didn't work. Try again in a moment.

tokens.lead: Scripts and pipelines call rvav's API with a token, as you. Its value is shown once.
tokens.copyNow: Copy it now: it won't be shown again.
tokens.notCopiedBody: Your browser refused: select the token and copy it.
tokens.noneBody: Make one above for a script or a pipeline.
tokens.revokeBody: The token stops working at once. This can't be undone: make a new token to replace it.
tokens.revokeConsequences: Scripts and pipelines that call rvav with it are refused from now on.
